name: Product Card
summary: Product listing card with media, close artist-and-piece identity, a two-line description, price, badges, and an optional compact Quick Look overlay.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Product card container composed on the same article as the canonical Card root.

anatomy.name: primaryImage
anatomy.description: Primary image when a hover image is also present.

anatomy.name: badges
anatomy.description: Badge stack for sale, new, or availability labels.

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.description: Optional product description visually clamped to two lines while preserving the complete text in the DOM.

anatomy.name: price
anatomy.description: Required Price composition, visibly separated from description and independent from optional footer actions.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional footer area for an explicitly composed secondary action; Price never belongs to this region.

anatomy.name: quickLook
anatomy.description: Optional intrinsic-width Button over the media that requests the target-owned Quick View for this product.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Fluid card size controlled by the parent grid.

states.name: hoverImage
states.description: Alternate image reveal and primary image scale on fine-pointer hover or keyboard focus within the card.

states.name: quickLookVisible
states.description: The compact media-overlay action is revealed on fine-pointer hover and whenever keyboard focus is within the card.

states.name: titleFocusVisible
states.description: The stretched title link produces a visible card-sized focus indicator.

behavior.name: canonicalCardComposition
behavior.description: The root article consumes canonical Card surface, border, radius, clipping, and resting shadow while Product Card suppresses Card hover elevation and shadow growth.

behavior.name: navigation
behavior.description: One descriptive title link is stretched across the passive card content; media is not a second link and separately interactive descendants remain above the stretched hit area.

behavior.name: descriptionClamp
behavior.description: The optional full description remains in DOM content and is visually limited to two lines with automatic ellipsis; Quick View or product detail owns complete reading.

behavior.name: quickLook
behavior.description: Optional intrinsic-width media-overlay Button requests the coherent target-owned Quick View. It is revealed on fine-pointer hover or focus-within, remains visible without hover or a fine pointer, includes product context in its accessible name when repeated, and performs no direct cart mutation. Product Form inside Quick View may provide add-to-cart.

behavior.name: artistVisibility
behavior.description: The optional artist/vendor name may be omitted or hidden without discarding its target-owned content value; its absence does not change the title or Price.

behavior.name: pricing
behavior.description: A visible Price composition is required and formatting is delegated to the Price dependency; optional footer actions cannot hide or replace it.

behavior.name: mediaRatio
behavior.description: One bounded semantic ratio applies to the complete passive media region; square is the default and portrait uses the shared 3:4 portrait proportion without exposing arbitrary numeric ratios.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Visible product title and accessible name of the single product-detail link.

properties.name: href
properties.description: Product-detail destination used by the title link.

properties.name: showVendor
properties.description: Keeps the optional artist/vendor content available while controlling whether its visible line is rendered.

properties.name: vendor
properties.description: Optional artist, vendor, or brand line.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Optional complete product description visually clamped to two lines without truncating the DOM text.

properties.name: imageAlt
properties.description: Alternative text for the primary product image.

properties.name: mediaRatio
properties.description: Shared semantic media proportion used consistently by Product Card collections; square maps to 1:1 and portrait maps to the established 3:4 portrait proportion.

properties.name: hoverImage
properties.description: Optional alternate media revealed by hover or focus-within.

properties.name: quickLookAction
properties.description: Optional intrinsic-width Button composition over the media that requests the target-owned Quick View for the represented product.

properties.name: price
properties.description: Required canonical Price composition that remains visible independently from optional actions.

properties.name: footer
properties.description: Optional secondary-action composition after the required Price.

accessibility: Use one descriptive product-title link as the card navigation target; keep media passive and do not add a redundant image link.
Give the primary product image descriptive alternative text when it adds information; alternate hover imagery for the same product uses empty alternative text.
Keep separately interactive descendants above the stretched title-link hit area and preserve their native focus and activation behavior.
Keep the canonical Price visibly present outside any optional footer action region.

Reveal Quick Look on fine-pointer hover or focus-within, keep it visible for coarse or no-hover input, include product context in its accessible name when cards repeat, and let the target open one coherent Quick View without direct cart mutation from the card.
Expose a visible card-sized focus indicator for the stretched title link and stop decorative transitions under reduced motion.
Badges and sale information should be exposed as text, not only color.

shopify.notes: The product-card snippet maps Shopify product data to canonical Card, Badge, Button, Price, media, title-link, clamped description, and a target-coordination Quick Look hook.
